Todos los gastos de la venta pública y cancelación de cargas, así como deudas (comunidad, IBI, etc. ), serán a cargo del cesionario.
No es posible visitar el inmueble al desconocer su estado de ocupación; su distribución puede no ajustarse a la realidad.
Para más información sobre la cesión, llámenos.

inv.desc_en:
As this is an Assignment of Auction Bid derived from a judicial auction, the amount must be approved by the competent court.
The property is transferred with the charges and encumbrances reflected in the registry, with the previous ones being subrogated.
All expenses of the public sale and cancellation of charges, as well as debts (community fees, property tax, etc. ), will be borne by the assignee.
It is not possible to visit the property as its occupancy status is unknown; its layout may not correspond to reality.
For more information about the assignment, call us.
WE DO NOT CHARGE AN INTERMEDIATION FEE TO THE BUYER.

Excellent opportunity to acquire this well-distributed property located in the town of Malaga. Very well located and with good access.

It is a property with great potential; its excellent layout and spaciousness make it the perfect canvas to redesign it.

Furthermore, its unbeatable location allows you to enjoy all the necessary services just a few minutes away. In addition, several houses and residential buildings can be found in the surrounding area, as well as some shops and small local businesses.

Do not think twice and do not miss this opportunity to acquire this property to build the home you have always dreamed of, as a second residence, or why not, as an investment.

Hipoges is a real estate platform where you can access thousands of real estate assets of different types such as homes, commercial premises, land, new construction.. . both for individuals and investors. Hipoges has a wide portfolio of real estate assets in Spain, Portugal, and Greece.

Do you need financing? We offer you the possibility of financing of up to 100% for the purchase of this property. Go to Finanwin. com, perform your simulation, and get the best offer for your mortgage in the most agile and simple way.
